verses.text: Better is a dry morsel and quietness with it Than a house full of feasting with strife.
verses.textZh: 設筵滿屋，大家相爭，不如有塊乾餅，大家相安。

verses.text: A servant who acts wisely will rule over a son who acts shamefully, And will share in the inheritance among brothers.
verses.textZh: 僕人辦事聰明，必管轄貽羞之子，又在眾子中同分產業。

verses.text: The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, But the LORD tests hearts.
verses.textZh: 鼎為煉銀，爐為煉金；惟有耶和華熬煉人心。

verses.text: An evildoer listens to wicked lips; A liar pays attention to a destructive tongue.
verses.textZh: 行惡的，留心聽奸詐之言；說謊的，側耳聽邪惡之語。

verses.text: He who mocks the poor taunts his Maker; He who rejoices at calamity will not go unpunished.
verses.textZh: 戲笑窮人的，是辱沒造他的主；幸災樂禍的，必不免受罰。

verses.text: Grandchildren are the crown of old men, And the glory of sons is their fathers.
verses.textZh: 子孫為老人的冠冕；父親是兒女的榮耀。

verses.text: Excellent speech is not fitting for a fool, Much less are lying lips to a prince.
verses.textZh: 愚頑人說美言本不相宜，何況君王說謊話呢？

verses.text: A bribe is a charm in the sight of its owner; Wherever he turns, he prospers.
verses.textZh: 賄賂在餽送的人眼中看為寶玉，隨處運動都得順利。

verses.text: He who conceals a transgression seeks love, But he who repeats a matter separates intimate friends.
verses.textZh: 遮掩人過的，尋求人愛；屢次挑錯的，離間密友。

verses.text: A rebuke goes deeper into one who has understanding Than a hundred blows into a fool.
verses.textZh: 一句責備話深入聰明人的心，強如責打愚昧人一百下。

verses.text: A rebellious man seeks only evil, So a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
verses.textZh: 惡人只尋背叛，所以必有嚴厲的使者奉差攻擊他。

verses.text: Let a man meet a bear robbed of her cubs, Rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.textZh: 寧可遇見丟崽子的母熊，不可遇見正行愚妄的愚昧人。

verses.text: He who returns evil for good, Evil will not depart from his house.
verses.textZh: 以惡報善的，禍患必不離他的家。

verses.text: The beginning of strife is [like] letting out water, So abandon the quarrel before it breaks out.
verses.textZh: 紛爭的起頭如水放開，所以，在爭鬧之先必當止息爭競。

verses.text: He who justifies the wicked and he who condemns the righteous, Both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.
verses.textZh: 定惡人為義的，定義人為惡的，這都為耶和華所憎惡。

verses.text: Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, When he has no sense?
verses.textZh: 愚昧人既無聰明，為何手拿價銀買智慧呢？

verses.text: A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.
verses.textZh: 朋友乃時常親愛，弟兄為患難而生。

verses.text: A man lacking in sense pledges And becomes guarantor in the presence of his neighbor.
verses.textZh: 在鄰舍面前擊掌作保乃是無知的人。

verses.text: He who loves transgression loves strife; He who raises his door seeks destruction.
verses.textZh: 喜愛爭競的，是喜愛過犯；高立家門的，乃自取敗壞。

verses.text: He who has a crooked mind finds no good, And he who is perverted in his language falls into evil.
verses.textZh: 心存邪僻的，尋不著好處；舌弄是非的，陷在禍患中。

verses.text: He who sires a fool [does so] to his sorrow, And the father of a fool has no joy.
verses.textZh: 生愚昧子的，必自愁苦；愚頑人的父毫無喜樂。

verses.text: A joyful heart is good medicine, But a broken spirit dries up the bones.
verses.textZh: 喜樂的心乃是良藥；憂傷的靈使骨枯乾。

verses.text: A wicked man receives a bribe from the bosom To pervert the ways of justice.
verses.textZh: 惡人暗中受賄賂，為要顛倒判斷。

verses.text: Wisdom is in the presence of the one who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.
verses.textZh: 明哲人眼前有智慧；愚昧人眼望地極。

verses.text: A foolish son is a grief to his father And bitterness to her who bore him.
verses.textZh: 愚昧子使父親愁煩，使母親憂苦。

verses.text: It is also not good to fine the righteous, [Nor] to strike the noble for [their] uprightness.
verses.textZh: 刑罰義人為不善；責打君子為不義。

verses.text: He who restrains his words has knowledge, And he who has a cool spirit is a man of understanding.
verses.textZh: 寡少言語的，有知識；性情溫良的，有聰明。

verses.text: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is considered wise; When he closes his lips, he is [considered] prudent.
verses.textZh: 愚昧人若靜默不言也可算為智慧；閉口不說也可算為聰明。
